g.text: Annual spending on the student's education (rupees, log scale)
Half of rural Sindh's students cost their families under Rs 4,500 a year,
but one in ten costs over Rs 15,500
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file merged with household file. Sample: 1,440 students (ed_total > 0), rural Sindh.
1 student(s) outside Rs 100 - Rs 1,000,000 excluded. Weighted by hhweight; bins 0.1 wide in log10 units.
